# Jeremiah 31 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "The time is coming," says the LORD, "when I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people."

**2** The LORD says: "The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness — when Israel went looking for rest,

**3** The LORD appeared to them from far away and said, 'I have loved you with a love that lasts forever. That is why I have been so patient and kind with you.

**4** I will rebuild you, and you will be rebuilt, My virgin Israel! Once again you will dance and celebrate with tambourines.

**5** Once again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria, and the farmers will plant and enjoy the harvest.

**6** A day is coming when watchmen will shout from the highlands of Ephraim, "Come, let's go up to Jerusalem to worship the LORD our God!"'

**7** The LORD continued describing the great restoration when He would gather His scattered people from every nation.

**31** "The day is coming," says the LORD, "when I will make a brand-new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.

**32** This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and brought them out of Egypt. They broke that covenant, even though I loved them as a husband loves his wife," says the LORD.

**33** "But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel after those days," says the LORD. "I will put My instructions deep within them, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people.

**34** And they will not need to teach their neighbors or their relatives, saying, 'You should know the LORD.' For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know Me already," says the LORD. "And I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins."

**35** The LORD affirmed the permanence of His promises — as certain as the sun, moon, and stars in their courses.

**40** The LORD affirmed the permanence of His promises — as certain as the sun, moon, and stars in their courses.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **31:3**: God's love isn't a reaction to Israel's goodness — it comes from eternity. This is the foundation for everything that follows: restoration happens because of who God is, not what we deserve.

- **31:31-34**: This is the most revolutionary passage in the entire Old Testament. A day is coming when God won't need rules carved in stone because they'll be carved on human hearts. Religion becomes relationship.

- **31:34**: Imagine: no one needing to say 'you should know God' because everyone already does. Complete forgiveness, complete knowledge, complete relationship. This is the ultimate destination of the biblical story.

— PNEUMA
